authoring.what this is: the introduction survey. a deterministic, no-AI list of facet questions. each option carries authored channels; on pick they round up into the RawPortrait. these are SEEDS — flesh them out.
authoring.indicator: FACT. a direct, near-certain read of THIS answer — true of ~99% who pick it. if it isn't near-certain, demote it to an implication.
authoring.implication: LEAD. what the answer implies — speculative, could be otherwise. a hypothesis, not a fact. (meaning lives in the answer, not in your head.)
authoring.identity: TYPES. competing, mutually-exclusive character-hypotheses the reading later resolves (e.g. THE STRIVER vs THE FLEEING-ONE). plural by design. distinct, recognizable — never vague flattery.
authoring.weight: 0-3. how hot this answer runs — emotional + meaningful valence. 0 inert (the cold baseline pick), 1 mild, 2 warm (a real lead), 3 hot (load-bearing). it ONLY sorts the RawPortrait amalgam (high signal rises, low signal sinks to the bottom). it NEVER gates, filters, or drops anything — the survey is a lossless reflection of this doc. author it per-answer — do NOT flatten to a constant or it sorts nothing.
authoring.shadow: ONE LINE. what it means to NOT pick this. when an answer is chosen, the shadows of ALL declined options are collected as that facet's negative space (never gated). kept to one line on purpose — that keeps negative space linear at one fragment per declined option.
authoring.hooks: RELATIONAL. fires pairwise against OTHER answers; also where contextual weight-modulation will live. empty for now.
authoring.notes: DIRECTIVE. what the system should DO, not what's true. operational or it's barnum. empty for now.

facets.question: how are the basics right now? housing, money, health
facets.hidden_target: material ground — recalibrates every other answer

options.label: handled
implications: stress they name later is more likely existential than situational
identities: the secure base — here for meaning, not rescue
options.shadow: the ground isn't actually settled

options.label: mostly
indicators: basics broadly held, with one live edge
implications: one domain — housing, money, or health — is quietly straining
identities: the steady-but-watchful
options.shadow: no quiet strain in the background — it's either fine or it's loud

options.label: some are slipping
indicators: real strain in at least one basic domain
implications: later flatness may be situational, not dispositional
identities: the quietly-precarious — holding it together in public
options.shadow: the strain isn't partial — it's either handled or total

options.label: barely — survival mode
implications: any fork sits on top of survival pressure
identities: the in-the-storm — needs ground before depth
options.shadow: survival isn't the crisis; the weight is elsewhere

facets.question: and your heart — where is it these days?

options.label: on my own
implications: charges may skew vocational / identity / family-of-origin over romantic
identities: the contentedly-solo OR the achingly-alone — the survey can't tell yet
options.shadow: there's someone in the picture

options.label: seeing someone
implications: hope and uncertainty both live here
identities: the hopeful-early — testing whether this one's real
options.shadow: nothing new or tentative on the romantic front

options.label: partnered
implications: the relationship is likely load-bearing in their life
identities: the paired — the partner is probably in the cast
options.shadow: no established bond carrying weight

options.label: married
implications: charges may be about the shape of a built life
identities: the long-bonded — comfort or quiet drift, undetermined
options.shadow: not inside a long formal commitment

options.label: it's complicated
indicators: romantic life is in flux or contradiction
implications: a live relational charge is likely
identities: the in-between — mid-rupture, mid-affair, or mid-decision
options.shadow: the romantic situation is legible, not tangled

facets.question: most days, the work you actually do feels like—

options.label: mine, i'd choose it
implications: the doing matches the wanting
identities: the called — work is a source, not a drain
options.shadow: the work isn't theirs in the way they'd want

options.label: fine, pays the bills
implications: healthy detachment or quiet resignation — undetermined
identities: the pragmatist OR the resigned
options.shadow: work is more than neutral — it's loved or hated

options.label: a slog, running empty
implications: misaligned and draining; possibly trapped
identities: the depleted — grinding past the point it pays back
options.shadow: work isn't actively draining them

options.label: in-between
implications: transitional — between roles or mid-rethink
identities: the in-transition
options.shadow: work-identity is settled, not in motion

facets.question: after a long week, the night that actually restores you—

options.label: out with people
implications: solitude later may read as deprivation, not preference
identities: the extrovert — charged by the room
options.shadow: crowds aren't where they refill

options.label: a few close people
implications: intimacy over volume
identities: the deep-not-wide
options.shadow: not the small-circle type

options.label: one person, or just me
implications: introvert-leaning
identities: the introvert-leaning
options.shadow: one-on-one or solitude isn't the restore

options.label: home, door shut
implications: introvert; if they crave belonging elsewhere, a live tension
identities: the recharger-alone
options.shadow: solitude isn't a refuge they reach for

facets.question: a day opens up with nothing in it. you—
facets.hidden_target: can you be without doing (mirror of yearning)

options.label: tackle the list
indicators: can't rest; output-driven even in freedom
implications: worth is likely staked on productivity
identities: THE STRIVER — rest feels like a debt owed
options.shadow: open time isn't immediately filled with doing

options.label: finally rest, guilt-free
implications: healthy relationship with stillness
identities: the at-ease — worth isn't staked on doing
options.shadow: rest doesn't come guilt-free

options.label: pretend to relax but stay half-on
implications: anxious activation under the stillness
identities: the half-on — vigilance dressed as leisure
options.shadow: they can actually switch off — or can't even pretend to

options.label: don't know what to do with myself
implications: empty time is threatening
identities: the unstructured-anxious — no compass for open time
options.shadow: they have a compass for open time

facets.question: your body is more a temple, a tool, or a problem?

options.label: a temple i tend
indicators: a reverent, invested relationship with the body
implications: cares for it; can tip into control
identities: the tender — OR the controlling-careful
options.shadow: the body isn't tended with reverence

options.label: a tool that gets me through
indicators: a utilitarian relationship to the body
implications: the body serves function; low felt relationship
identities: the utilitarian
options.shadow: the body is more than a means to an end

options.label: a problem i manage
indicators: the body is an ongoing struggle
implications: health, image, or chronic issue is live
identities: the at-war — the body is a battleground
options.shadow: the body isn't a daily struggle

options.label: a stranger, i'm barely in it
implications: lives up in the head; the not-noticing is the signal
identities: the disembodied
options.shadow: they're present in the body, not above it

facets.question: be honest — do you stay too long, or leave too soon?

options.label: stay too long
indicators: over-tolerant; lets things run past their expiry
implications: over-loyal, or conflict-averse about endings
identities: the over-stayer — loyal or trapped
options.shadow: they don't over-stay; if anything they leave early

options.label: leave too soon
implications: flight-prone or self-protective
identities: the bolter — leaves when it gets hard
options.shadow: they don't bolt; if anything they linger

options.label: i've done both
indicators: no consistent exit bias, or unexamined
implications: context-dependent
identities: the inconsistent — the pattern isn't owned yet
options.shadow: the exit pattern is consistent, not mixed

options.label: i time it about right
implications: secure, or simply not-yet-burned
identities: the well-calibrated (or untested)
options.shadow: the timing is off in one direction and they know it

facets.question: when you're angry, it tends to come out—

options.label: hot, i let it out
implications: volatile or honest, depending on the aftermath
identities: the hot — anger goes out, not in
options.shadow: anger doesn't come out loud

options.label: cold, i go distant
implications: punishes through absence
identities: the cold-shoulder — aggression in retreat
options.shadow: withdrawal isn't the anger move

options.label: it doesn't, i swallow it
implications: turned inward or somatized; the missing anger is the tell
identities: the swallower — anger pointed at the self
options.shadow: the anger has an outlet

options.label: depends who it's with
implications: safe with some, suppressed with others — a hierarchy
identities: the selective — anger maps the safety map
options.shadow: anger isn't relationship-gated — it's consistent

facets.question: when someone you love goes quiet, you—

options.label: reach out
implications: anxious-leaning; low tolerance for the unread
identities: the pursuer — closes the distance
options.shadow: silence isn't met by pursuit

options.label: wait
implications: secure space-giving OR avoidant non-chase — undetermined
identities: the waiter — secure or avoidant
options.shadow: they don't give space — they move

options.label: assume the worst
implications: abandonment hypervigilance
identities: the catastrophizer — silence means leaving
options.shadow: silence doesn't trip catastrophe

options.label: let it go
implications: genuine non-attachment OR self-protective preemption
identities: the releaser — settled or pre-emptively walled
options.shadow: they don't release — they hold on

facets.question: fastest way to ruin your whole day?

options.label: being criticized
implications: criticism lands on the foundation, not the surface
identities: the competence-staked — being wrong is the wound
options.shadow: worth isn't pinned to being right

options.label: being dismissed
indicators: worth runs through mattering and recognition
implications: the wound is invisibility
identities: the unseen — needs to be taken seriously
options.shadow: invisibility isn't the wound

options.label: letting someone down
implications: the people-pleaser tell, sideways
identities: the disappointer-fearing — worth is in not-failing-others
options.shadow: worth isn't pinned to not-failing-others

options.label: a day i wasted
implications: an unproductive day registers as a moral failing
identities: THE STRIVER — worth staked on achievement
THE FLEEING-ONE — stays busy to outrun something
options.shadow: worth isn't pinned to output

facets.question: picture going home where you grew up. the feeling in your chest—

options.label: warmth
indicators: a secure origin; home is a resource
implications: the healthy backstop — and likely real
identities: the secure-rooted
options.shadow: home isn't simply a resource

options.label: tightness, i brace
indicators: home activates old roles or tension
implications: a wound with an address
identities: the bracer — old roles reassert at home
options.shadow: home doesn't make them brace

options.label: heaviness
implications: absence, estrangement, or what it wasn't
identities: the grieving — home is loss
options.shadow: the origin isn't heavy with grief

options.label: not much, i don't go back
implications: peaceful detachment OR active avoidance — the flatness may be protective
identities: the estranged — detached or avoidant
options.shadow: they still go back; there's a live tie

facets.question: which of these do you want most?

options.label: love
implications: inverts to a fear of being unlovable or abandoned
identities: the love-hungry
options.shadow: connection isn't the deepest want right now

options.label: freedom
implications: inverts to a fear of constraint or entrapment
identities: the freedom-seeker
options.shadow: they're not chafing against constraint

options.label: wisdom
implications: inverts to a fear of being foolish or deceived
identities: the seeker — often mid-transition
options.shadow: understanding isn't the hunger

options.label: beauty

identities: the aesthete
options.shadow: aliveness and aesthetics aren't the ache

options.label: security
implications: inverts to a fear of chaos; read against basics
identities: the ground-seeker
options.shadow: stability isn't what's missing

options.label: belonging

options.label: power

facets.question: closest to true about how your life has gone—

options.label: a lot was luck & timing
